english: [TAB]Thus spoke the Martyr Mishahel, as the Luonnotar stood chained in the city plaza awaiting Junil's justice: [PARAGRAPH:1]"You ask us to repent? We ask you the same. We are all Children of The One, you, and I, and all your so-called gods alike, no matter who denies it. His angels may have made this world, but only by His leave. This warrants them no worship. We will adore only The One. The Twenty-One have all sinned and fallen short of the glory of The One, by far more than the vilest mortal falls short of your Junil's majesty. Our Elder Brothers, the angels, swore to guide us to enlightenment, to make us all their equals. Instead, like petulant children, they have turned their charges into pawns for petty squabbles among themselves. Now it falls to us to enlighten them. Fighting evil with evil can never be called justice. Junil is no better than Agares, only a greater hypocrite. Every "god" willing joined Agares' rebellion. They are all oath-breakers. The All-Father offered his children true freedom, but from fear and lust for power they have chosen bondage. Agares stole the Gems of Creation and forged their links to the infinite planes, but each "god" gladly enslaved his own soul to his to a separate precept. Our own sire, Nemed, came near to redemption when he surrendered his divinity, but in his folly defied The One and damned us all to "immortality. " Only The One should last forever. I endure only by his will. This world soon shall pass away. We will all be judged. Perhaps some shall escape Creation and enter into the True Heaven. Repent now while there is still a chance, lest you instead be punished along with your idols. "[PARAGRAPH:2]With this their trial was over. The Priors had heard enough. Such egregious blasphemy demanded special punishment. Hanging or decapitation would not suffice. These fools must be made an example to the public in the most dramatic way: a Pillar of Fire called down from the heavens. The Pontiff's prayers had been answered with the miracle on multiple occasions during the late war against The Ashen Veil, and he knew Junil would be eager to purge this greater scourge. [PARAGRAPH:2]Junil indeed hated the gospel of the Luonnotar, because he feared it might be true. How could any mortal know such things? The terms of The Compact forbid any angel from sharing such secrets with the living. One worry filled his soul with terror: could The One have returned, and revealed himself only to these mortals? Impossible. . . or was it? Junil was now forced to doubt his own righteousness. Was not Agares first great sin the creation of a world and people required to worship him, and kept in ignorance of the truth? This line of thought would have gone on, until he recalled an obscure clause that Dagda's Archangel had inserted into The Compact which precisely dictated his proper course action. He suppressed his existential angst by following the letter of the law as usual. [PARAGRAPH:2]The people watched in awe as they saw the flames descending from the sky, with greater force than had ever descended before. The Prior was certain of his victory, while the Luonnotar stoically accepted their unjust fate. No one predicted what came next. The pillar descended and engulfed them, but not a hair on their heads or a fiber of their clothing was singed. The same could not be said of the chains binding them, or the flesh of their persecutors, or the stones of the Basilica itself, which rapidly melted away. Half the city cried in anguish, and were reduced to ash. The only survivors within miles of the plaza were the condemned, and those who had hearkened to their words. [PARAGRAPH]Rumors spread that the basilica was burned by sorcery, and armies amassed to avenge the massacre. Assailed at every stop, the Luonnotar always proved invulnerable to divine magic yet often fell to mundane blades. They continued to preach and attract new converts, but were always on the verge of extinction until finding sanctuary among the Grigori. Cassiel sent word assuring them that they could live in peace within his realm so long as they never tried to emulate their persecutors. Refugees of all faiths were welcome to live in peace among the Grigori, if they could tolerate that blasphemy was the national pastime. The Luonnotar gained a base from which to organize evangelism abroad, but rarely won converts among their skeptical new compatriots. Mishahel continued to petition the fallen archangel for an audience and for some endorsement for his beliefs, but was always ignored. The one blasphemy Cassiel cannot tolerate is the notion that The One is petty enough to desire any cult of worshipers. [PARAGRAPH:3]The Children of The One religion may start in either one two ways: through a random event that may occur in any city under any state religion, or the Grigori civilization discovering [LINK=TECH_ARCANE_LORE]Arcane Lore[\\LINK]. [PARAGRAPH]Cities with this and another faith are both present have a chance of triggering a Monotheist Revolt, in which this faith will force its competitors out. If the religion removed was a state religion, then the city will revolt as if newly conquered. The Children of The One itself can never be a state religion. [PARAGRAPH]The [LINK=UNIT_LUONNOTAR]Luonnotar[\\LINK], the religion's only unique unit, can travel through rival territory without open boarder agreements in order to spread its faith among cities and units alike. Priests of other religions who adopt this faith are defrocked--the units are automatically deleted if anyone tries to use them. The Luonnotar unit is immune to magic and has no spells of its own, but is very strong against disciple units and will target them even in stacks with better defenders. Any unit which converts to this religion becomes [LINK=PROMOTION_MAGIC_RESISTANCE]resistant to magic[\\LINK] and also [LINK=PROMOTION_REBEL]rebellious[\\LINK] against any owner that is running any state religion. If a leader with a state religion orders such units to fight against the Grigori, they will most likely defect. The religion's only building is its holy shrine, [LINK=BUILDING_UNHARMED_MARTYRS]The Unmarred Martyrs[\\LINK]. This provides [LINK=BONUS_MANA_FORCE]Force mana[\\LINK], great person points towards [LINK=UNIT_ADVENTURER]Adventurers[\\LINK], and increased war weariness for your enemies. Units in the city are 100% resistant to magic, gain the Scourge promotion, and lose the [LINK=PROMOTION_DIVINE]Divine[\\LINK] promotion (priests loose access to their spells just by passing through the city). It makes other religious buildings cause a great deal of unhappiness. [PARAGRAPH]Units of this religion will never return as either [LINK=UNIT_ANGEL]Angels[\\LINK] or [LINK=UNIT_MANES]Manes[\\LINK]. \r\n[PARAGRAPH:3]All priests have their Ardas weakened by the presence of the Children of the One, especially in cities nearby.  Once the Children of the One have enough influence, priests may abandon their faith and become rebellious, possibly disbanding themselves of defecting to the Grigori.

[TAB]殉道者米沙赫尔如是说道，其时天母审判官正被锁链缚于城中广场，等候朱尼尔的审判：[PARAGRAPH:1]“你们要我们悔改？我们也这般要求你们。我们全都是太一之子——你、我，以及你们所谓的一切神祇，无论谁否认这一点。他的天使或许造就了这个世界，但那也只是奉他的准许。这并不值得让人对他们加以崇拜。我们只崇敬太一。这二十一位全都犯了罪，亏缺了太一的荣耀，其亏缺之甚，远超最卑劣的凡人之亏缺于你们朱尼尔的威严。我们的兄长——众天使——曾立誓引领我们走向启悟，令我们皆与他们平等。可他们却像任性的孩童，把托付于己的众生变成他们彼此间琐碎争吵的棋子。如今，启迪他们的重任落到了我们身上。以恶抗恶，永不能称之为正义。朱尼尔不比阿加雷斯好，只是个更大的伪君子。每一位‘神’都心甘情愿加入了阿加雷斯的叛乱。他们全是背誓者。万物之父赐予他的孩子真正的自由，但出于恐惧与对权力的贪欲，他们却选择了束缚。阿加雷斯窃取了造物之宝石，铸就它们与无限位面的连结，可每一位‘神’都甘愿将自己的灵魂奴役于一条各自的戒律。我们自己的父神涅梅德，在放弃其神性时曾几近救赎，却因其愚妄违抗太一，将我们全都诅咒进了‘不朽’。唯有太一才应永存。我仅凭他的意志得以存续。这个世界不久便将逝去。我们全都将受审判。或许有些人能逃出造物，进入真正的天堂。趁着尚有机会，此刻便悔改吧，免得你们反倒与你们的偶像一同受罚。”[PARAGRAPH:2]至此，他们的审判结束了。圣堂主教们已听得够多。如此骇人的亵渎需要特殊的惩罚。绞刑或斩首都不足够。这些蠢货必须以最富戏剧性的方式公开示众：一道自天而降的炎之柱。在近来对抗混沌之灰烬的战争中，教皇的祈祷曾多次以这一奇迹得到应验，他深知朱尼尔会急于涤除这更大的祸患。[PARAGRAPH:2]朱尼尔确实憎恨天母审判官的福音，因为他害怕它可能是真的。凡人怎会知晓这等事？契约的条款禁止任何天使向生者分享这类秘密。一桩忧虑令他的灵魂充满恐惧：太一莫非已经归来，且只向这些凡人显现了自身？不可能……又或许可能？朱尼尔如今被迫怀疑起自己的正义。阿加雷斯的第一桩大罪，不正是创造了一个被要求崇拜他、并被蒙蔽于真相之外的世界与民族吗？这一思绪本会继续下去，直到他想起达格达的大天使插入契约中的一条晦涩条款，那条款恰恰规定了他应有的行事之道。他一如既往地遵循律法的字面条文，压下了自己那存在层面的焦虑。[PARAGRAPH:2]人们敬畏地望着火焰自天而降，其威势胜过以往任何一次降临。圣堂主教确信自己已然胜券在握，而天母审判官则平静地接受着他们不公的命运。无人料到接下来发生的事。那火柱降下，将他们吞没，然而他们头上一根毫发、衣上一缕丝线都未被燎焦。缚着他们的锁链却不然，那些迫害者的血肉、乃至巴西利卡本身的石块也不然，它们迅速熔化殆尽。半座城池的人哀号着，化为灰烬。广场方圆数里之内唯一的幸存者，便是那些被定罪之人，以及那些曾聆听其言者。[PARAGRAPH]传言四起，说那座巴西利卡是被巫术焚毁的，军队集结起来要为这场屠杀复仇。天母审判官在每一处遭到围攻，却总是证明自己对神圣魔法刀枪不入，却又常常倒在凡俗的刀剑之下。他们继续布道、吸引新的皈依者，却始终濒临灭绝，直到在格利高里中觅得庇护。卡西尔传话向他们保证，只要他们绝不试图效仿其迫害者，便可在他的国度内安然生活。各种信仰的难民都可在格利高里中和平共处，只要他们能容忍亵渎神明乃是这个国度的全民消遣。天母审判官获得了一处向外传播福音的据点，却鲜少在其满腹狐疑的新同胞中赢得皈依者。米沙赫尔继续恳请那位堕落的大天使赐予一次觐见、并对其信仰有所认可，却始终被置之不理。卡西尔唯一无法容忍的亵渎，便是那种认为太一竟渺小到会渴求一群崇拜者的念头。[PARAGRAPH:3]太一之子宗教可以两种方式之一开始：通过任何国教下的任一城市中可能发生的一个随机事件，或格利高里文明研究出[LINK=TECH_ARCANE_LORE]神秘典籍[\\LINK]。[PARAGRAPH]同时存在本教与另一信仰的城市，有几率触发一次一神论叛乱，届时本教将把其竞争者逐出。若被移除的宗教是国教，则该城将如新被征服一般叛乱。太一之子本身永远无法成为国教。[PARAGRAPH]本教唯一的独特单位[LINK=UNIT_LUONNOTAR]天母审判官[\\LINK]，可在没有开放边界协议的情况下穿越敌方领土，以便在城市与单位间传播其信仰。皈依本信仰的其他宗教祭司会被剥夺圣职——若有人试图使用他们，这些单位会被自动删除。天母审判官单位免疫魔法，自身没有法术，但对使徒类单位极为强力，即便在有更强防御者的堆叠中也会锁定它们。任何皈依本教的单位都会变得[LINK=PROMOTION_MAGIC_RESISTANCE]抵抗魔法[\\LINK]，并对任何采用任何国教的拥有者变得[LINK=PROMOTION_REBEL]反叛[\\LINK]。若一位拥有国教的领袖命令此类单位对抗格利高里，他们极有可能倒戈。本教唯一的建筑便是其圣祠[LINK=BUILDING_UNHARMED_MARTYRS]无瑕殉道者[\\LINK]。它提供[LINK=BONUS_MANA_FORCE]法则能量[\\LINK]、朝向[LINK=UNIT_ADVENTURER]冒险者[\\LINK]的伟人点数，并增加你敌人的厌战情绪。城中单位百分之百抵抗魔法、获得涤罪者晋升，并失去[LINK=PROMOTION_DIVINE]神圣[\\LINK]晋升（祭司仅仅经过此城便会失去其法术的使用权）。它使其他宗教建筑造成大量不满。[PARAGRAPH]本教的单位永远不会作为[LINK=UNIT_ANGEL]天使[\\LINK]或[LINK=UNIT_MANES]恶灵[\\LINK]归来。\r\n[PARAGRAPH:3]所有祭司的阿尔达都会因太一之子的存在而被削弱，尤其在邻近的城市。一旦太一之子拥有足够的影响力，祭司便可能舍弃其信仰、变得反叛，甚至可能自行解散或倒戈至格利高里。

[TAB]There have been men have worshiped The White Hand of Mulcarn in every era since before the time of the Godswar, but they have never been many. During the Age of Magic, his stoic Frost Speakers were tolerated but disrespected. Mulcarn was considered the least of the gods, at a time when his nemesis Bhall was considered the greatest. Although the least evil of all those who sided with Agares against The One, he was a supremely jealous god who grew to greatly hate humanity for their devotion to every god but himself. As Nostalgia is his very nature, he longed to return to how things were in the Godswar, when man was a primitive being subject to the whims of the divine and gods were not bound by the regulations of The Compact. [TAB]The Fall of Bhall gave him an opportunity to make this a reality. With no god to oppose him, he was able to maneuver the one people who honored him, the nearly destitute Illians, into completing a ritual that summoned him into the plane of Erebus. Sucellus was sent to enforce The Compact and prevent Mulcarn's conquest of the world, but he failed in his endeavor. His body was broken in seven pieces and buried in distant regions of the infinite plane, to prevent them from being reunited and allowing his spirit to return from the Netherworld to challenge The God of Winter again. Where a god failed, and man succeeded. Kylorin, Archmage of the Seventh Circle and former Emperor of All Mankind, was sent on a mission by Nantosuelta (the Goddess of Enchantment and Virtue, who loved Sucellus greatly) to end The Age of Ice and retrieve the Heart of Sucellus from within Mulcarn's citadel. (She had already managed to have the other six pieces of his body gathered together. ) He gathered and reforged the pieces of the Godslayer, a weapon created as a symbol and manifestation of The Compact, and destroyed Mulcarn once and for all. [PARAGRAPH]With their god vanquished, the followers of The Hand fell to an all time low. They were slow to adapt to a changing world, and reviled by more powerful nations who had been their subjects. The few who maintained the faith however were more fanatical than ever. They realized that the true object of worship was not the person of the god, but his precept. His precept remains, and possessed a powerful will to regain an avatar. It has chosen Auric Ulvin, an orphan from a small outlying Illian village called Brigdarrow, to lead it. He is the greatest magical prodigy born in the current age, and was a very good natured child before the precept claimed him. Driven mad with power, he may end up more evil than Mulcarn ever was by the time he completes his goal and ascends into godhood. [PARAGRAPH:1]This state religion is a prerequisite of [LINK=PROJECT_THE_DEEPENING]The Deepening[\LINK], [LINK=PROJECT_THE_DRAW]The Draw[\LINK], and the [LINK=PROJECT_ASCENSION]Ascension[\LINK] rituals. 
		
		

[PARAGRAPH:3]Priests and Demons of [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]The White Hand[\LINK] will have their ardas most strengthened by the influence of [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]The White Hand[\LINK], but also strengthened to a lesser degree by the [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]The Runes of Kilmorph[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_STEWARDS_OF_INEQUITY]The Stewards of Inequity[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_ANOINTED]The Anointed[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]The Council of Esus[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]The Between[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\LINK]. Its arda will be weakened by [LINK=RELIGION_CHILDREN_OF_THE_ONE]The Children of The One[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_MATRONAE]The Matronae[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_EMBER_LEGION]The Ember Legion[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_UNBLEMISHED]The Unblemished[\LINK], the Felllowship of the Leaves, [LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]The Grey Council[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_BROTHERHOOD_OF_WARDENS]The Brotherhood of Wardens[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Empyrean[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]The Ringgivers[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]Cult of the Dragon[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Order[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]The House of Plenty[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]The Foxmen[\LINK]. It will be weakened in Good lands and strengthened in Evil lands. It will be strengthened by proximity to [LINK=BONUS_MANA_ICE]Ice Mana[\LINK], Letum Frigus, the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_WHISPERING_WOOD]Whispering Wood[\LINK], [LINK=FEATURE_BLIZZARD]Blizzards[\LINK], [LINK=FEATURE_ICE]Sea Ice[\LINK], [LINK=TERRAIN_SNOW]Ice[\LINK], [LINK=TERRAIN_GLACIER]Glacier[\LINK], [LINK=TERRAIN_WASTELAND]Wasteland[\LINK], or [LINK=TERRAIN_TUNDRA]Tundra[\LINK] terrain. It is weakened by [LINK=BONUS_MANA_FIRE]Fire Mana[\LINK], [LINK=BONUS_MANA_NATURE]Nature Mana[\LINK], [LINK=TERRAIN_DESERT]Desert[\LINK], or [LINK=TERRAIN_BURNING_SANDS]Burning Sands[\LINK] terrain.

[TAB]自诸神之战之前的时代起，每个纪元都有人崇拜穆卡恩的白手，但他们从来人数不多。魔法纪元期间，他那些坚忍的霜语者虽被容忍，却不受尊敬。穆卡恩被视为最微末的神祇，而其时他的死敌巴尔却被奉为至高。尽管他是所有追随阿加雷斯对抗太一者中最不邪恶的一个，他却是一位极其善妒的神，逐渐对人类满怀憎恨，只因他们虔诚地崇拜除他以外的每一位神。由于怀旧本就是他的天性，他渴望回到诸神之战时的旧貌——那时人类还是受神明反复无常之念摆布的原始存在，诸神也不受契约条规的束缚。[TAB]巴尔的陨落给了他将此变为现实的机会。既无神祇与他相抗，他便得以操纵那唯一敬奉他的民族——近乎赤贫的伊利安人——去完成一场将他召入埃瑞布斯位面的仪式。苏塞鲁斯被派去执行契约、阻止穆卡恩征服世界，却功败垂成。他的躯体被断为七块，埋于无限位面的遥远各处，以防它们重新聚合、让他的魂灵从冥界归来再度挑战冬之神。神祇失败之处，凡人却成功了。凯洛林——第七环大魔法师、昔日的全人类皇帝——受南托苏埃尔塔（附魔与美德之女神，她深爱苏塞鲁斯）之托，肩负一项使命：终结冰之纪元，并从穆卡恩的堡垒中取回苏塞鲁斯之心。（她已设法将他躯体的其余六块聚拢到了一处。）他聚齐并重铸了屠神剑的碎片——那是一件作为契约之象征与化身而造的武器——将穆卡恩彻底摧毁。[PARAGRAPH]随着他们的神被击败，白手的信徒们跌至有史以来的最低谷。他们迟迟未能适应变化的世界，又为曾是其臣属的更强大民族所憎恶。然而少数坚守信仰者却比以往更为狂热。他们领悟到，真正的崇拜对象并非神的其身，而是其戒律。他的戒律尚存，且怀有一股重获化身的强大意志。它选中了奥里克·尤尔文——一个来自伊利安偏远小村布里格达罗的孤儿——来引领它。他是当今世代降生的最伟大的魔法奇才，在戒律占据他之前，是个心地极善的孩子。被权力逼疯的他，到他完成目标、飞升成神之时，可能会变得比穆卡恩曾经的样子更加邪恶。[PARAGRAPH:1]此国教是[LINK=PROJECT_THE_DEEPENING]深化[\LINK]、[LINK=PROJECT_THE_DRAW]牵引[\LINK]与[LINK=PROJECT_ASCENSION]飞升[\LINK]诸仪式的前提。
		
		

[PARAGRAPH:3][LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]白手[\LINK]的祭司与恶魔，其阿尔达受[LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]白手[\LINK]的影响强化最甚，但也受[LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]基鲁莫夫之痕[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_STEWARDS_OF_INEQUITY]不义之守[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_ANOINTED]受膏者[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]杰斯议会[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]混沌之灰烬[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]夹隙[\LINK]与[LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]纷争之子[\LINK]的较小程度强化。它的阿尔达会被[LINK=RELIGION_CHILDREN_OF_THE_ONE]太一之子[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_MATRONAE]母神[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_EMBER_LEGION]余烬军团[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_UNBLEMISHED]无瑕者[\LINK]、绿叶之友、[LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]灰色议会[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_BROTHERHOOD_OF_WARDENS]守护者兄弟会[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]天空的教诲[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]赐环者[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]巨龙教团[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]绝对秩序[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]丰饶之家[\LINK]与[LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]狐人[\LINK]削弱。它在善良的土地上被削弱，在邪恶的土地上被强化。它会因邻近[LINK=BONUS_MANA_ICE]冰之能量[\LINK]、寒冰宫殿、[LINK=IMPROVEMENT_WHISPERING_WOOD]低语之林[\LINK]、[LINK=FEATURE_BLIZZARD]暴风雪[\LINK]、[LINK=FEATURE_ICE]海冰[\LINK]、[LINK=TERRAIN_SNOW]冰[\LINK]、[LINK=TERRAIN_GLACIER]冰川[\LINK]、[LINK=TERRAIN_WASTELAND]荒原[\LINK]或[LINK=TERRAIN_TUNDRA]苔原[\LINK]地形而强化。它会被[LINK=BONUS_MANA_FIRE]炎之能量[\LINK]、[LINK=BONUS_MANA_NATURE]自然能量[\LINK]、[LINK=TERRAIN_DESERT]沙漠[\LINK]或[LINK=TERRAIN_BURNING_SANDS]灼热沙漠[\LINK]地形削弱。

english: [TAB]Forgotten and ignored by the gods, some mortals have turned to worshiping the great dragons who once fought over the land and now lie dormant beneath it. They do not form any unified faith, but are a collection of many conflicting minor cults devoted to different beasts. All agree that the gods' weapons of mass destruction are themselves divine, and find their draconic deities to be much more acceptable than empty prayers offered in temples. All seek to awaken these weapons of mass destruction and see them wreak havoc on their enemies. [PARAGRAPH]These cults can pop up in any land, but are most accepted among the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_KURIOTATES]Kuriotates[\\LINK] and [LINK=CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM]Sheaim[\\LINK]. Those civilizations can complete the [LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]Stir from Slumber[\\LINK] ritual in any city, spreading the Cult to that city, rather than only completing it in a city where the faith is already present. [PARAGRAPH:2]The Cult of the Dragon is unlike other religions. It is not founded by being the first to research a technology. It typically begins when the barbarians create [LINK=UNIT_ACHERON]Acheron's [\\LINK] [LINK=BUILDING_WYRMHOLD]Wyrmhold[\\LINK] in one of their cities and calls the great Furnace Dragon into the world. It can also be founded by the Kuriotates world spell [LINK=SPELL_LEGENDS]Legends[\\LINK], which moves the holy city to the site where it was cast and spreads the religion and the caster's culture to random cities, or by the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_KURIOTATES]Kuriotates[\\LINK] or [LINK=CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM]Sheaim[\\LINK]completing [LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]Stir from Slumber[\\LINK].[PARAGRAPH]The Dragon Cult has numerous disadvantages for most civilizations, although these do not apply to the Kuriotates, the Sheaim, or anyone whose team controls a Dragon. It makes an empire harder to manage and control. Cities that are home to a Dragon Cult are likely to revolt. Anyone with the Fanaticism technology can train a [LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_FANATIC]Dragon Fanatic[\\LINK] in a Cult city and use it to spread negative effects to rival cities. These Fanatics can be transformed into devotees of specific dragons when they visit their Wyrmholds or hear them [LINK=SPELL_ROAR]Roar[\\LINK]. A standard Fanatic will follow any dragon, but once devoted to a specific beast it will ignore the calls of other dragon species. Dragons generated by Wyrmholds start as sedentary lair guardians, but a Fanatic can use the [LINK=SPELL_BESEECH_DRAGON]Beseech Dragon[\\LINK] ability to call the beasts forth from their lairs and try to convince them to attack their enemies. There is a chance that a Dragon will spawn under your control, if you have the right mana, alignment, and follow the Cult of the Dragon as your State Religion. You cannot adopt this as your State religion unless you already have a Dragon.
chinese: [TAB]被诸神遗忘与漠视，一些凡人转而崇拜那些曾在这片土地上争斗、如今蛰伏于其下的巨龙。他们并未形成任何统一的信仰，而是许多彼此冲突、各自敬奉不同巨兽的小教派的集合。他们全都认同，诸神的大规模杀伤性武器本身即是神圣的，并觉得他们那些龙形神祇远比在神庙中献上的空洞祷告更可接受。他们全都设法唤醒这些大规模杀伤性武器，好看着它们向其敌人肆虐。[PARAGRAPH]这些教派可在任何土地上冒出，但在[LINK=CIVILIZATION_KURIOTATES]库里奥塔特[\\LINK]与[LINK=CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM]塞安[\\LINK]中最受接纳。那些文明可在任何城市完成[LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]自沉睡中苏醒[\\LINK]仪式，将教团传播至该城，而不必只在已存在该信仰的城市中完成它。[PARAGRAPH:2]巨龙教团与其他宗教不同。它不是通过率先研究出某项科技来创立的。它通常在蛮族于其某座城市建造[LINK=UNIT_ACHERON]阿切隆的[\\LINK][LINK=BUILDING_WYRMHOLD]龙巢[\\LINK]、将伟大的熔炉巨龙召入世界时兴起。它也可由库里奥塔特的世界法术[LINK=SPELL_LEGENDS]传奇[\\LINK]创立——该法术将圣城迁至其施法之处，并向随机城市传播该宗教与施法者的文化——或由[LINK=CIVILIZATION_KURIOTATES]库里奥塔特[\\LINK]或[LINK=CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM]塞安[\\LINK]完成[LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]自沉睡中苏醒[\\LINK]创立。[PARAGRAPH]巨龙教团对多数文明有诸多不利，尽管这些不利并不适用于库里奥塔特、塞安，或任何其团队控制着一条巨龙的玩家。它使帝国更难管理与掌控。作为巨龙教团大本营的城市极易叛乱。任何拥有宗教狂热科技的人都能在一座教团城市训练[LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_FANATIC]巨龙狂信徒[\\LINK]，用它向敌对城市散播负面效果。这些狂信徒在造访其龙巢或听闻它们[LINK=SPELL_ROAR]咆哮[\\LINK]时，可转变为特定巨龙的信徒。普通狂信徒会追随任何巨龙，但一旦献身于某头特定巨兽，便会无视其他龙种的召唤。由龙巢生成的巨龙起初是定居的巢穴守护者，但狂信徒可使用[LINK=SPELL_BESEECH_DRAGON]恳请巨龙[\\LINK]能力将巨兽从其巢穴召出，并试图说服它们攻击其敌人。若你拥有合适的能量、阵营，并以巨龙教团为国教，则有几率生成一条归你控制的巨龙。除非你已拥有一条巨龙，否则无法将此定为你的国教。

[TAB]the Laeran Cord thrived throughout the Age of Magic, when the knowledge they curated was prized. These priests of Oghma were welcome in most realms, for they shared their lore freely with all who yearned to learn and stayed as neutral as the god they served. [PARAGRAPH:1]The Age of Ice spelled their ruin. Oghma ignored their prayers to save them. Embarr might have helped, but Ceridwen slayed and tore the archangel asunder, scattering his mind, flesh, and spirit across creation. [PARAGRAPH:1]All original research ceased as the order desperately labored to protect what humanity would need to know to rebuild civilization. The mages among in their ranks were not enough to save them as they fled back to ever fewer hidden libraries. The savage Doviello delighted in their demise, burning both books and men whenever found. [PARAGRAPH:1]In time their hunting parties stopped returning. Some priests went mad. Others died of starvation, or old age. the Laeran Cord dwindled to a single man: a scholar with nothing but a frozen world to study, a teacher without anyone to teach, a high priest only by default. His true name is forgotten. We know him now simply as "Akharien," which means "the last one" in the ancient tongue. [PARAGRAPH:1]In time, the Doviello came for him. Still a young man, born well into the Age of Ice, he knew nothing of world outside what he read in the last library's books. They offered a chance to flee, to survive as a wolf in the wilderness, to one day win the right to join the pack and hunt with them. [PARAGRAPH:1]Instead he threw himself on the books. He begged them to burn him but only spare the library. He promised to tell them all the stories contained within, and to teach them all about the medicinal uses of the few herb that survived in the region. [PARAGRAPH:1]They rejected his offer, believing as they did that the strong need no such knowledge and that the weak it helps preserve deserve to die. This last priest of the Laeran Cord was burned to death within his library. [PARAGRAPH:1]His spirit never passed to Oghma's vault. It lingered to haunt the ruins, fluttering among the dust and ashes which once were books. His ghost had more power than he ever did in life. It scared the Doviello away, but blessed other Vagrants with dreams of distant times and places to inspire them. [PARAGRAPH:1]A new Laeran Cord was refounded early in the Age of Rebirth. The new priests discovered the meager ruins of The Last One's library, but nothing of value remained within except the High Priest's Crown. This was taken to the new church that it might serve Oghma again. It is rumored that the spirit of Akharien followed, and continues to guide the order in relearning what was forgotten. [PARAGRAPH]There is a heresy that emerged within the Cord, rejecting the benevolent guidance of Akharien and wishing to risk experiments with darker forms of magic. Gaelan was a talented summoner and mage in the Laeran Cord. Frustrated with the slow progress within the Cord, Gaelan started the Circle of Gaelan. The Circle gained a reputation for dangerous acts followed by tragedy. While they still believed they were serving Oghma, the new faith in fact followed Ceridwen. There were escaped summoned creatures, death of livestock, a fire that nearly destroyed a village and human experimentation. The worst mistake of the Circle of Gaelan was an attempt to summon a True Angel of Prophecy. They managed to summon A Root of Fear, an Aspect of Mammon whose power had been changed from true Foresight to Foreboding of horrors that become self-fulfilling prophecies. Their greatest fear came true, and the confinement circle failed. The Root of Fear killed all the members except Gaelan himself, drowning them in fears until there was nothing left of them. The vision destroyed Gaelan's body and mind. His past was forgotten, his body horribly disfigured. The battle spread to Euphoria, the Dreamworld where Gaelan's Mind Palace was shattered by Caer lest it fall to Fear. This spread nightmares across Creation. Gaelan himself was reborn as a priest of the Undertow, known only as the Burnt Priest. [PARAGRAPH:2]State religion allows access to:[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=UNIT_GAELAN]Gaelan Sedracious[\LINK] (world unit)[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=UNIT_HIGH_PRIEST_LAERAN]Hierophants [\LINK] (unit)[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_ARCHIVE]Archives [\LINK] (building)[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB]Halves the production cost of: [PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_MAGE_GUILD]Mage Guilds[\LINK] [PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_LIBRARY]Libraries[\LINK] [PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_ACADEMY]Academies[\LINK] [PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_GREAT_LIBRARY]The Library of Oghma[\LINK][PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_CROWN_OF_AKHARIEN]The Crown of Akharien[\LINK] [PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_PALACE_AMURITES]The Amurite Palace[\LINK] [PARAGRAPH:2]Units of this faith are more likely to gain affinity for [LINK=BONUS_MANA_METAMAGIC]Metamagic[\LINK] mana
		
		
		
[PARAGRAPH:3]Priests and Angels of [LINK=RELIGION_LAERAN_CORD]The Laeran Cord[\LINK] will have their ardas most strengthened by the influence of [LINK=RELIGION_LAERAN_CORD]The Laeran Cord[\LINK], but also strengthened to a lesser degree by [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Empyrean[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]The House of Plenty[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]The Ringgivers[\LINK], and Eternal Cabal. Its arda will be weakened by [LINK=RELIGION_CHILDREN_OF_THE_ONE]The Children of The One[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_MATRONAE]The Matronae[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]The Grey Council[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]The Undertow[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]Cult of the Dragon[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]The Between[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_STEWARDS_OF_INEQUITY]The Stewards of Inequity[\LINK]. It will be strengthened in Neutral lands and slightly weakened in Good or Evil lands. It will be strengthened by proximity to [LINK=BONUS_MANA_METAMAGIC]Meta Magic Mana[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CAVE_OF_ANCESTORS]the Cave of the Ancestors[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_REMNANTS_OF_PATRIA]the Remnants of Patria[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_RUINS]Ruins[\LINK], or [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CITY_RUINS]City Ruins[\LINK]. It is weakened by Mind Mana[\LINK].

[TAB]莱兰绳结在整个魔法纪元繁荣兴盛，那时他们所守护的知识备受珍视。这些奥格玛的祭司在多数国度都受欢迎，因为他们向一切渴求学问之人慷慨分享其学识，并如他们所侍奉的神一般保持中立。[PARAGRAPH:1]冰之纪元注定了他们的覆灭。奥格玛无视了他们求他拯救的祷告。恩巴尔本可能相助，但瑟丽德雯杀死了这位大天使并将其撕裂，把他的心智、血肉与魂灵散播于造物各处。[PARAGRAPH:1]随着教团竭力守护人类重建文明所需知晓的一切，所有原创研究都停止了。他们退守至日渐稀少的隐秘图书馆，其中的法师亦不足以拯救他们。野蛮的多维洛对他们的覆亡欣喜若狂，每逢遇见便将书籍与人一并焚毁。[PARAGRAPH:1]假以时日，他们的狩猎队不再归来。一些祭司疯了。另一些死于饥饿，或死于衰老。莱兰绳结凋零至只剩一人：一位除了一个冰封的世界别无可研究的学者，一位无人可教的教师，一位仅因别无他人而当上的高阶祭司。他的真名已被遗忘。我们如今只以“阿卡瑞恩”称呼他，在古语中意为“最后一人”。[PARAGRAPH:1]假以时日，多维洛来找他了。他仍是个年轻人，生于冰之纪元的深处，除了在最后那座图书馆的书中所读，他对外面的世界一无所知。他们给了他一个逃亡的机会——去荒野中作为一头狼求存，有朝一日赢得加入狼群、与他们一同狩猎的权利。[PARAGRAPH:1]他却扑向了那些书。他恳求他们烧死他、只留下图书馆。他许诺将其中所载的一切故事都讲给他们听，并把该地区仅存的几种草药的药用之法尽数教给他们。[PARAGRAPH:1]他们拒绝了他的提议，因为他们坚信强者无需此等知识，而它所助存的弱者理应死去。莱兰绳结这最后一位祭司，被烧死在了他的图书馆之中。[PARAGRAPH:1]他的魂灵从未归入奥格玛的宝库。它徘徊着，萦绕于废墟之间，在那些曾是书籍的尘埃与灰烬中飘荡。他的鬼魂拥有比他生前更强的力量。它吓退了多维洛，却以远方时空的梦境祝福其他流浪者，激励他们。[PARAGRAPH:1]一个新的莱兰绳结在重生纪元早期重新创立。新的祭司们发现了“最后一人”那座图书馆微薄的废墟，其中除了高阶祭司之冠外，别无有价值之物留存。此冠被带往新的教会，好让它再度侍奉奥格玛。传言阿卡瑞恩的魂灵追随而来，继续引领教团重新习得那些被遗忘的知识。[PARAGRAPH]绳结内部曾涌现一股异端，抵拒阿卡瑞恩仁慈的引领，一心想去冒险尝试更黑暗形式的魔法。盖伦是莱兰绳结中一位才华横溢的召唤师与法师。因不满绳结内部进展缓慢，盖伦创立了盖伦之环。此环因一桩桩危险之举继而酿成的悲剧而声名远扬。尽管他们仍自以为在侍奉奥格玛，这一新信仰实则追随的是瑟丽德雯。曾有召唤生物逃脱、牲畜死亡、一场几乎摧毁一座村庄的大火，以及活人试验。盖伦之环最严重的错误，是一次召唤真正的预言天使的尝试。他们竟召来了一个恐惧之根——玛门的一个化身，其力量已从真正的预见变为对种种恐怖的预感，而这些预感会成为自我应验的预言。他们最大的恐惧成真了，禁锢法阵失效。恐惧之根杀死了除盖伦本人外的所有成员，将他们溺毙于恐惧之中，直到他们荡然无存。那异象摧毁了盖伦的身体与心智。他的过往被遗忘，他的身体被可怕地毁容。战斗蔓延到极乐界——那梦境世界中，盖伦的心智殿堂被凯尔击碎，以免它落入恐惧之手。这令噩梦散播于造物各处。盖伦本人重生为一名暗涌的祭司，人们只以焦炎祭司称呼他。[PARAGRAPH:2]国教可解锁：[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=UNIT_GAELAN]盖伦·塞德拉修斯[\LINK]（世界单位）[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=UNIT_HIGH_PRIEST_LAERAN]祭司长[\LINK]（单位）[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_ARCHIVE]档案馆[\LINK]（建筑）[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB]将以下建筑的生产成本减半：[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_MAGE_GUILD]法师公会[\LINK][PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_LIBRARY]图书馆[\LINK][PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_ACADEMY]学院[\LINK][PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_GREAT_LIBRARY]奥格玛图书馆[\LINK][PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_CROWN_OF_AKHARIEN]阿卡瑞恩之冠[\LINK][PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=BUILDING_PALACE_AMURITES]阿姆莱特宫殿[\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]本信仰的单位更易获得对[LINK=BONUS_MANA_METAMAGIC]超魔[\LINK]能量的亲和
		
		
		
[PARAGRAPH:3][LINK=RELIGION_LAERAN_CORD]莱兰绳结[\LINK]的祭司与天使，其阿尔达受[LINK=RELIGION_LAERAN_CORD]莱兰绳结[\LINK]的影响强化最甚，但也受[LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]天空的教诲[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]丰饶之家[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]赐环者[\LINK]与永恒秘社的较小程度强化。它的阿尔达会被[LINK=RELIGION_CHILDREN_OF_THE_ONE]太一之子[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_MATRONAE]母神[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]灰色议会[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]纷争之子[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]暗涌[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]巨龙教团[\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]夹隙[\LINK]与[LINK=RELIGION_STEWARDS_OF_INEQUITY]不义之守[\LINK]削弱。它在中立的土地上被强化，在善良或邪恶的土地上略微削弱。它会因邻近[LINK=BONUS_MANA_METAMAGIC]超魔能量[\LINK]、[LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CAVE_OF_ANCESTORS]先祖之洞[\LINK]、[LINK=IMPROVEMENT_REMNANTS_OF_PATRIA]帕提亚遗迹[\LINK]、[LINK=IMPROVEMENT_RUINS]废墟[\LINK]或[LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CITY_RUINS]城市废墟[\LINK]而强化。它会被精神能量[\LINK]削弱。

english: As the faith of the Matronae spreads, and other religions loose influence on the world, the ability of the old gods to act in Erebus wanes. If the Matronae faith reaches 100% of the world population, divine magic will die and all priests will be useless. [PARAGRAPH:2]History:[PARAGRAPH]At the end of the Age of Rebirth the demon plagued lands of the Fane of Lessers were conquered and the Throne of Hell destroyed. Not content to just cleanse creation, the archangel Basium lead his angelic army into hell to continue his war. Decades passed and in that time the Bannor used the Crucible to weaken the world's magic. Powerful artifacts of past ages became dusty relics, and those with the talent to be mages in prior ages were rarely able to manifest their power. The Age of Invention had started. [PARAGRAPH]During this age three new goddesses appeared on creation, they were known as the Matronae. Morrigan was the goddess of fate and a great white temple was built to her on the cliffs of the Elohim city of Niveus. From Niveus came the gas Effluvium, which powered city lamp posts and caused divine visions (and would also be used by the Kuriotates to build airships). Sarabride was the goddess of vengeance and her temple was a great foundry built in the reclaimed city of Braduk the Burning. From her city came all sorts of wonders including coal powered trains. The citizens of Braduk built rail systems to connect the major cities of men. The last was Cliodna, the goddess of dreams, and her temple was built on the docks of the Bay of Laurus. From her temple came great steam powered ships that opened up travel to the distant shores of creation. [PARAGRAPH]All three goddesses were active in creation and their religions grew quickly. The religions of ages past, of distant gods who might answer occasional prayers were forgotten, or destroyed by the followers of the Matronae. What use is myth when gods walk among us?[PARAGRAPH:2]The Matronae are the guises assumed by the archangels Gyra, Condatis, and Brigit, who acquired three Masks of the Coven of the Black Candle and used them to steal three Gems of Creation from their respective gods' vaults. They are not interested in becoming gods, or receiving worship. They cannot become avatars that embody their dominions. The compact does not bind them, so they don't need worshipers to permit their actions in any region. They cannot have priests with divine powers, since they don't control a dominion, don't have a fleet of angels to bless their followers, etc. But they are all archangels of fallen gods and they are worried about their dominions becoming corrupted. There is little they can do about it directly, though wars are beginning to start over it. Arak and the Gossamer Legion are coming for Morrigan. After the attack on hell, madness begins spreading through Lanun and Elohim lands as Hastur moves against Cliodna. And the battle between the Swanmay and Sarabride is a prelude to waking up Bhall. [PARAGRAPH]The goal of the Matronae is a lesson from Cassiel. They want to kill worship of the old gods so that the compact keeps them from being able to act in creation. But where Cassiel preached about how the old gods were unworthy, the Matronae have replaced those religions with new fake ones. If they can wipe out the old religions, the gods won't be able to impact creation and damage done by corrupted dominions will be mitigated. They are also reducing the ability of all the gods by claiming the gems. The gods no longer have infinite wells to draw from in three of the six materials. This doesn't mean they aren't powerful, but if the Godswar restarted the gods would be much weaker without the gems. [PARAGRAPH]The Matronae are working closely together. Sarabride and Cliodna are not opposed despite the fact that they are archangels from opposed dominions. They certainly don't agree on everything, but they are working toward the same plan. They rescued Basium from Hell with the hope that he could recover the Font of Life (and Gyra makes a habit of rescuing her idealistic brother), though Basium is nearly destroyed and the Font is guarded by an active god, and they don't currently have another mask (which wouldn't be absolutely necessary, but would certainly help). [PARAGRAPH:2]The Matronae wear Masks of the Coven of the Black Candle for a number of reasons. Protecting their identity is a big one, though in time powers will assume or know who they are. The more they can minimize this the better. Powerful sorcerers can summon and bind archangels (although the Crucible makes this difficult, if not impossible), so the Matronae do not want anyone knowing who they are. They also want to diminish any belief in the old religions, not support it by having people know they are a part of it. Most importantly the masks prevent detection. Anyone hunting, scrying, summoning them won't be able to find them with the masks on. In time, however, the truth will come out. [PARAGRAPH]It is not common knowledge that the Opalus Mortis, Corundum Ardens, and Beryllus Abyssi have been stolen in the first place. Other gods (much less mortals) cannot see into the vaults where Arawn, Bhall, and Danalin once kept them. The gods only knew that a new religion had started centered around some very powerful figures. The evil gods could however deduce the source of their powers and guess at their identities from what happened during their attack on hell. Arak (who has been fighting Gyra for centuries since she killed his wife) and Laroth are also onto Morrigan. [PARAGRAPH:3]All priests have their Ardas weakened by the presence of the Matronae in the world, especially in cities nearby. Once the Matronae influence is strong enough, priests in the vicinity of Apostates will abdondon their leaders and become Apostates themselves
chinese: 随着母神信仰的传播、其他宗教对世界失去影响力，旧日诸神在埃瑞布斯行事的能力也随之衰减。若母神信仰达到世界人口的百分之百，神圣魔法将会消亡，一切祭司都将无用。[PARAGRAPH:2]历史：[PARAGRAPH]重生纪元末期，饱受恶魔侵扰的下等者圣殿之地被征服，地狱王座被摧毁。大天使巴希姆不满于只涤净造物，率其天使大军攻入地狱，继续其战争。数十年过去，其间班诺尔用熔炉削弱了世界的魔法。往昔纪元的强大神器沦为蒙尘的遗物，那些在先前纪元有天赋成为法师的人，也鲜能显现其力量。创造纪元开始了。[PARAGRAPH]此纪元期间，造物上出现了三位新的女神，她们被称作母神。莫瑞甘是命运女神，一座宏伟的白色神庙为她建于埃洛希姆城市尼维乌斯的峭壁之上。从尼维乌斯产出一种名为“逸气”的气体，它为城市灯柱供能、引发神圣异象（也将被库里奥塔特用来建造飞艇）。莎拉布莱德是复仇女神，她的神庙是一座宏大的铸造厂，建于收复的燃烧者布拉杜克城中。从她的城市产出各式各样的奇物，包括燃煤火车。布拉杜克的市民建起铁路系统，连接起人类的各大城市。最后一位是克莉奥娜，梦境女神，她的神庙建于劳鲁斯湾的码头之上。从她的神庙产出宏大的蒸汽动力船只，开辟了通往造物遥远海岸的航路。[PARAGRAPH]三位女神都活跃于造物之中，她们的宗教迅速壮大。往昔纪元的宗教，那些偶尔或会回应祷告的遥远神祇，被遗忘了，或被母神的信徒所摧毁。当诸神行走于我们之间时，神话又有何用？[PARAGRAPH:2]母神是大天使吉拉、康达提斯与布里吉特所假借的外形，她们取得黑烛结社的三张面具，用它们从各自神祇的宝库中窃走了三颗造物之宝石。她们无意成为神祇，也不图受人崇拜。她们无法成为体现其权柄的化身。契约并不约束她们，故而她们无需崇拜者便可在任何地区行事。她们不能拥有身具神力的祭司，因为她们不掌控任何权柄、没有天使舰队来祝福其信徒，等等。但她们全都是陨落诸神的大天使，且担忧她们的权柄会遭腐化。对此她们几乎无法直接采取行动，尽管为此已开始爆发战争。阿拉克与游丝军团正冲莫瑞甘而来。地狱一役之后，随着哈斯图尔对克莉奥娜发难，疯狂开始在拉努恩与埃洛希姆的土地上蔓延。而天鹅少女与莎拉布莱德之间的战斗，则是唤醒巴尔的前奏。[PARAGRAPH]母神的目标源自卡西尔的一课。她们想要扼杀对旧神的崇拜，好让契约阻止它们在造物中行事。但卡西尔宣讲的是旧神如何不配受崇拜，母神却以新的虚假宗教取代了那些宗教。若她们能抹除旧宗教，诸神便无法影响造物，被腐化的权柄所造成的损害也将得到缓解。她们还通过占据宝石来削弱所有神祇的能力。在六种材质中的三种上，诸神不再拥有可供汲取的无尽之泉。这并不意味着它们不再强大，但倘若诸神之战重启，没有了宝石的诸神会虚弱得多。[PARAGRAPH]母神紧密协作。莎拉布莱德与克莉奥娜尽管是来自对立权柄的大天使，却并不彼此为敌。她们当然并非事事意见一致，但正朝着同一个计划努力。她们把巴希姆从地狱救出，指望他能取回生命之泉（而吉拉素有搭救她那理想主义兄弟的习惯），尽管巴希姆已近乎被摧毁、生命之泉又由一位活跃的神所守护，且她们眼下并无另一张面具（那并非绝对必要，但必定大有助益）。[PARAGRAPH:2]母神佩戴黑烛结社的面具有诸多缘由。保护其身份是一大原因，尽管终有一日，各方势力会推测出或知晓她们是谁。她们越能将此减到最低越好。强大的巫师能够召唤并束缚大天使（尽管熔炉令此举困难重重、乃至无从下手），故而母神不愿任何人知晓她们是谁。她们还想削弱人们对旧宗教的一切信仰，而非因为让人知道自己身在其中而支持了它。最重要的是，面具能防止侦测。任何搜寻、占卜、召唤她们的人，只要面具戴着，便无法找到她们。然而假以时日，真相终会大白。[PARAGRAPH]死亡之蛋白石、炽燃刚玉与深渊绿柱石一开始便已被盗一事，并非人所共知。其他神祇（更遑论凡人）无法窥见阿劳恩、巴尔与达纳林曾存放它们的宝库。诸神只知道一个围绕着几位极强大人物的新宗教出现了。然而邪恶诸神能够从它们攻打地狱时的遭遇中推断出其力量的来源、并猜出她们的身份。阿拉克（自吉拉杀死他的妻子以来，已与她战斗了数百年）与拉罗斯也盯上了莫瑞甘。[PARAGRAPH:3]所有祭司的阿尔达都会因母神存于世间而被削弱，尤其在邻近的城市。一旦母神的影响力足够强大，叛教者附近的祭司便会舍弃其领袖，自己也变成叛教者

english: Aristocrats in many lands say "Noblesse oblige. " They believe they must at least appear virtuous, in order to inspire hope and loyalty among the commoners. The Calabim deride such delusions. The Grand Broods know that the victims of the worst abuse are often the most loyal. With methods both magic and mundane, the Brood Guards turn broken souls into fanatics. Calabim thralls fear nothing more than their masters, and would more gladly slit their own throats or wrestle a dragon than risk a Vampire's slightest displeasure. Some learn to enjoy submission. Many tolerate it for the chances it offers to dominate others. A few cling to ambitions of rising in the ranks, perhaps even to becoming a Vampire Lord. Some believe that existence is nothing but suffering, that the heavens are no better than the hells, and that the only escape for an immortal soul is the nirvana of a vampire's kiss. Others believe there is no such thing as a spirit, but that a consciousness can endure indefinitely if it is consumed by and merges with the mind of a Vampire. Most have toyed with several excuses in the past but have ceased trying to rationalize their attachment to the status quo. After a lifetime learning helplessness, they lack the strength of will necessary to imagine things getting better, even if they also cannot fathom them being any worse. The Broods do not care what tales the human cattle tell themselves, so long as they follow orders without question and are quick to present themselves as snacks.
chinese: 许多国度的贵族都说“贵族有其义务”。他们认为自己至少必须显得德行高尚，以在平民中激发希望与忠诚。卡拉比姆对这类痴念嗤之以鼻。众大血族深知，遭受最恶劣虐待的受害者往往最为忠诚。血族卫兵以魔法与凡俗两种手段，将破碎的灵魂化为狂信徒。卡拉比姆的奴仆最惧怕的莫过于其主人，他们宁可割喉自尽或与巨龙搏斗，也不愿冒险惹得吸血鬼哪怕一丝不悦。有些人学会了享受臣服。许多人则为它所提供的支配他人的机会而甘愿忍受。少数人执着于晋升的野心，或许乃至成为一位吸血鬼领主。有些人相信存在无非是苦难，天堂并不比地狱更好，一个不朽灵魂唯一的解脱便是吸血鬼之吻带来的涅槃。另一些人相信根本不存在魂灵这种东西，但若一个意识被吸血鬼吞食并与其心智融合，它便能无限存续。多数人过去曾拿几种借口来搪塞，如今却已不再试图为其对现状的依附寻找理由。历经一生学会无助之后，他们缺乏想象事情会变好所必需的意志之力，纵然他们也无法设想事情能变得更糟。众血族并不在意这些人类牲畜给自己讲些什么故事，只要他们唯命是从、并乐于随时把自己奉上作为点心。

Then they let go and the corpse rises as the undead Drown.[PARAGRAPH:1]This ability upgrades a Warrior into the Drown. It can only be used if the players state religion is Undertow and if the warrior is in a city with a Temple of the Undertow building or on the same tile as a Cultist.

english: [TAB]The Undertow priestess stood quietly on the seashore, her long flowing robe dancing in the storm. She could have done this anywhere on land, but nowhere did it feel as real and invigorating as by the sea, by the storm.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Oh mighty masters, hear my call", she spread out her arms and raised her eyes upwards, towards the storm rising above the sea. "My body and mind are yours to command, my sanity but a tool at your bidding. Honor my sacrifice to you, and grant me the sight of your servant." Intoning the words, she could feel the might that lurked deep below the waves, the ancient and inhuman power. The overwhelming sensation was enough to blind her to the living world and threw her mind into a deep blackness that contained only the ever-stormy nightmares of the Undertow. In the horrible, chaotic maelstrom of bizarre sensations and feelings never meant for mortal eyes, she forced her will, shaped in her head the image of a twisted, many-eyed octopus. As she concentrated on the vision, two of the fish's eyes were torn out of its head in a slimly plop. They stared at the chaos around them and floated in the air, untouched by the raging water and wind.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Your eyes shall be mine", she said in a dry whisper, reached out for the eyes and closed her fist around them. As she felt the large, slimy things against her skin, the storm in her mind quieted and she once again stood on the shore.[PARAGRAPH:2]"And my eyes they will be", she finished, now seeing with two pairs of eyes as she opened her fists to reveal the gifts of her gods. She said nothing more as she lowered her hands and willed the eyes to rise up in the air, go out and spy upon the enemies of the Undertow.
chinese: [TAB]暗涌女祭司静静地立于海滨，她那飘逸的长袍在风暴中舞动。她本可在陆上任何地方施行此事，但没有哪里能像海边、像风暴中这般，让它显得如此真切而振奋人心。[PARAGRAPH:1]“哦，伟大的主人们，听我召唤”，她张开双臂，抬眼向上，望向海面之上升腾的风暴。“我的身体与心智任凭你们号令，我的理智不过是听你们差遣的工具。请垂顾我对你们的献祭，赐我以你们仆从之视界。”吟诵着这些话语，她能感觉到深藏于波涛之下的伟力，那古老而非人的力量。那压倒一切的感受足以令她对活生生的世界视而不见，将她的心智抛入一片深邃的漆黑之中，其中唯有暗涌那永恒风暴般的噩梦。在那可怖、混沌、种种从非为凡人之眼所设的奇异感受与情绪的漩涡里，她强行凝聚意志，在脑海中塑造出一只扭曲的、生着许多眼睛的章鱼的形象。当她专注于那异象时，那鱼的两只眼睛被从头颅中扯出，发出一声黏腻的噗声。它们凝视着周遭的混沌，悬浮于空中，不为狂暴的水与风所动。[PARAGRAPH:1]“你的眼睛将归我所有”，她以干涩的低语说道，伸手去够那双眼睛，将拳头合拢于其上。当她感觉到那对硕大黏滑之物贴着自己的肌肤时，她心中的风暴平息了，她再度立于岸边。[PARAGRAPH:2]“而它们也确将是我的眼睛”，她说完，此刻已以两对眼睛视物，她张开拳头，露出诸神的馈赠。她什么也没再说，只垂下双手，以意志令那双眼睛升上空中，飞出去窥探暗涌的敌人。

english: [TAB]"My lady... the results of your experiment. Nearly all of them... twisted beyond comprehension..."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Those who weren't cut out for this shouldn't have volunteered," the voice of the priestess was as harsh and merciless as the young man's was quivering. "The ones who perish here wouldn't have survived combat anyway."[PARAGRAPH:1]The men and the women who'd volunteered lay prone on the open field, all covered by monstrous deformities. One seemed to have had all the blood sucked out of him, another man's testicles had grown so huge they had crushed his toes under their weight. The priestess was walking among them, inspecting each before moving on. Clearly, it seemed, one of the ones who wasn't cut out for it was the aide she'd been assigned.[PARAGRAPH:1]"But my lady," he tried one more time, flinching away his gaze from the man whose bowels had exploded rather violently out of his stomach, "There wasn't anything wrong with these troops, that's why you chose them... they would have made excellent soldiers had not..."[PARAGRAPH:1]"And you would make an excellent Drown if you did not shut up," the priestess replied coldly, finally quieting the aide. She stopped in front of one of her test subjects, pausing to take a closer look. The elven woman had been pretty once, but no stretch of the imagination would let you use that word of her anymore. Any fat she might have had was muscle now, and all the muscle she had was grown large enough to stretch and tear away the skin that had once covered it. Her eyes were bulging out of her head, the expanding tissue having forced them out of their sockets-but despite everything, she eyed the priestess with an air of wary satisfaction.[PARAGRAPH:1]"I think this... is exactly what we need," for the first time today, a smile slowly appeared on the priestess's lips. Her eyes glowing, she turned to the aide, joyous laughter in her voice. "I knew the Undertow would not forsake us! They have gifted some of us inhuman strength, enough to take down all of our foes. Find the others who look like this, they're the ones we want."[PARAGRAPH:1]"And... the others?" the man slowly asked.[PARAGRAPH:1]"The others? Oh," the priestess shrugged, having entirely forgotten about the failures already, "I don't think they can be made into Drown anymore, can they? It really doesn't matter, do what you want with them." She turned away from the aide, smiling and looking at the elven woman with love and adoration in her eyes.[PARAGRAPH:1]"You are so pretty that way, my dear. I'm so glad you made it."
chinese: [TAB]“大人……您实验的结果。它们几乎全都……扭曲得无法理解……”[PARAGRAPH:1]“那些不适合此道的人本就不该自愿参加，”女祭司的嗓音一如那年轻人的颤抖般冷酷无情。“在这里丧命的人，反正也熬不过战斗。”[PARAGRAPH:1]那些自愿者，男男女女，俯卧在这片空地上，个个满身骇人的畸变。一人似乎被吸干了全身的血，另一人的睾丸胀得如此之大，其重量已将他的脚趾压碎。女祭司在他们之间踱步，逐一查看后再移向下一个。显然，那些不适合此道者之一，正是分派给她的这名助手。[PARAGRAPH:1]“可是大人，”他又试了一次，将目光从那个肠子相当猛烈地从腹中炸出的人身上瑟缩着移开，“这些兵卒本没有任何毛病，那正是您选中他们的缘由……他们本会成为出色的士兵，若不是……”[PARAGRAPH:1]“而你若不闭嘴，也会成为一个出色的溺死者，”女祭司冷冷地回道，终于令那助手噤了声。她在一名试验对象前停下，驻足细看。这名精灵女子曾经美丽，但如今无论怎样想象，你都无法再用那个词形容她。她或许曾有的任何脂肪如今都成了肌肉，而她所有的肌肉都长得足以撑裂、扯开曾覆于其上的皮肤。她的双眼从头颅中凸出，膨胀的组织将它们逼出了眼窝——但纵然如此，她却带着一丝审慎的满足打量着女祭司。[PARAGRAPH:1]“我想这……正是我们所需的，”今日头一回，一抹微笑缓缓浮上女祭司的唇角。她双眼放光，转向那助手，嗓音里满是欢欣的笑意。“我就知道暗涌不会遗弃我们！他们赐予了我们中的一些人非人的力量，足以打倒我们所有的敌人。去找出其他长成这样的人，他们才是我们想要的。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“那……其他人呢？”那男人缓缓问道。[PARAGRAPH:1]“其他人？哦，”女祭司耸了耸肩，早已把那些失败品忘得一干二净，“我看他们再也变不成溺死者了，是吧？其实无所谓，随你怎么处置他们。”她转身背对那助手，微笑着，以满含爱意与倾慕的目光望着那精灵女子。[PARAGRAPH:1]“你那样子真美，我亲爱的。我真高兴你挺了过来。”

english: [TAB]The Kraken's swimming was slow, leisurely. Thoughts took a while to cross from one edge of its immense brain to the other, the movements of its tentacles almost independent of its mind. Somewhere, far away on the surface, it could faintly sense a distant call which it couldn't resist. But it was not yet in any rush, instinctively knowing that the caller would need time to prepare.[PARAGRAPH:1]In a lazy motion, one of its tentacles made a slow wave around it, dozens of the small fish surrounding it getting caught in the suction cups. It brought the tentacle back to one of its mouths, dined on its snack. A huge swarm of fish followed it wherever it went-countless of them would end up as its meal, but even more would get to dine on its bigger catches. The swarm stretched back for tens of miles, twice as far as the Kraken itself.[PARAGRAPH:1]Gradually it started getting closer to the surface, could feel the call growing more and more demanding. The fish dispersed in fright and then reassembled as the Kraken began swimming faster, faster than it usually ever did. The alien presence was now a burning sun buried in its brain, no longer willing to tolerate any delay. For all of its size, dwarfing small islands, the Kraken was only a servant for the true lords of the sea.[PARAGRAPH:1]When the chosen of the Undertow called, it would obey and serve with all its might.
chinese: [TAB]大海妖游得缓慢而悠然。念头要花上好一阵才能从它那巨大脑海的一端游到另一端，其触手的动作几乎独立于它的心智。在某处，在遥远的海面之上，它能隐约感觉到一声无法抗拒的遥远召唤。但它尚不急切，本能地知道召唤者需要时间准备。[PARAGRAPH:1]它慵懒地摆动，一条触手在身周缓缓一挥，环绕着它的数十条小鱼被吸盘捕获。它将触手送回其一张口中，享用它的点心。一大群鱼无论它去往何处都追随着它——它们中数不清的鱼终将成为它的餐食，但更多的鱼则得以享用它更大的猎获。这群鱼向后绵延数十英里，比大海妖自身还要长上一倍。[PARAGRAPH:1]它渐渐开始靠近海面，能感觉到那召唤愈发迫切。鱼群受惊四散，又随着大海妖开始游得更快——快过它平素任何时候——而重新聚拢。那异界的存在此刻已是一轮埋于它脑中的灼热骄阳，再不愿容忍任何拖延。尽管它体型庞大、令小岛都相形见绌，大海妖也不过是大海真正主人们的一介仆从。[PARAGRAPH:1]当暗涌的天选者召唤时，它将以全力服从、效命。

english: The Peliguard is a massive temple that is continuously being constructed by a race of powerful golems. They pay little attention to any of the petitioners, angels or even Nantosuelta herself unless anyone attempts to stop their work or damage the temple. In which case they react violently.[PARAGRAPH]The temple itself is an academy and arena in one. This is the place where angelic champions are trained and prepared for war. Most of this time is devoted to combat, but magic, siegecraft, armorsmithing, weaponsmithing, military strategy, history and mental, physical and spiritual endurance are also trained along with a wide variety of other subjects. Anything that helps prepare them to battle the forces of hell.[PARAGRAPH]This is one of the few vaults where angels of other dominions travel freely. Angels of the other good and neutral gods can often be found here training, or teaching.[PARAGRAPH]There are various, elaborate training programs. But the most intense is known as the Suffering. The Suffering is an assault on the body, mind and spirit of those going through it. Nantosuelta herself watches over the trial. And those that fail often do so by falling and becoming demons. If so Nantosuelta destroys them. Those that survive become paragons of faith. It has been said that no one that survives the Suffering will ever fall. And so far, that has been true. To these few are given the most sensitive of tasks, to bear an artifact that cannot be lost, to travel into the hells or to serve one that cannot be betrayed.
chinese: 裴利卫所是一座宏大的神庙，由一支强大的魔像种族持续不断地建造着。它们对任何祈请者、天使、乃至南托苏埃尔塔本人都毫不理会，除非有人试图阻止它们的工作或损坏神庙。届时它们会暴烈地作出反应。[PARAGRAPH]这座神庙集学院与竞技场于一身。这里是天使勇士受训、备战之处。这段时间大多用于战斗，但魔法、攻城术、护甲锻造、武器锻造、军事战略、历史，以及心智、体魄与精神的耐力，也连同各式各样的其他科目一并受训。任何有助于让他们做好与地狱之力搏斗的准备的事物。[PARAGRAPH]这是少数几处其他权柄的天使得以自由往来的宝库之一。其他善良与中立神祇的天使常可在此处受训，或授业。[PARAGRAPH]此处有形形色色、精心设计的训练课程。但其中最严酷的一项被称作“苦难”。苦难是对经历它者的身体、心智与精神的一场摧残。南托苏埃尔塔本人监视着这场试炼。而那些失败者往往因堕落、化为恶魔而失败。若是如此，南托苏埃尔塔便将他们摧毁。那些幸存下来的人则成为信仰的典范。据说，凡熬过苦难者，永不会堕落。而迄今为止，此言不虚。这少数几人被授予最为敏感的任务：去背负一件不容丢失的神器、去深入诸地狱，或去侍奉一个不容背叛之人。

english: Like normal Berserkers, Brujahs cause collateral damage to four other units when attacking stacks. They also start with the vampire promotion and the abilities that come with it, and their Rage ability grants Burning Blood and Enraged to other units nearby instead of only the caster. .
chinese: 与普通狂战士一样，狂暴吸血鬼攻击堆叠时会对另外四个单位造成溅射伤害。它们还开局便带有吸血鬼晋升及其附带能力，且其震怒能力会向附近的其他单位授予燃烧之血与暴怒，而非只作用于施法者本身。

english: A powerful attacking unit that causes collateral damage to units in the opponent's stack. Their defense is low, so they are most effective when teamed up with high defense units like archers to protect from enemy retaliation. Berserkers can use the Berserk ability, which grants them the Burning Blood and Rage promotions.
chinese: 一种强力的攻击单位，会对对手堆叠中的单位造成溅射伤害。它们的防御较低，故与弓兵等高防御单位协同、以防敌方反击时最为有效。狂战士可使用狂暴能力，该能力为它们授予燃烧之血与震怒晋升。
